label: Diagram
blurb: Mermaid: flowchart, sequence, ER, gantt, chart, and 19 more.

controls.label: Re-render
controls.title: Re-render the diagram from the current source
controls.doc: Render the current source again. Rendering is otherwise debounced while you type, and a syntax error keeps the last good picture on screen — this is how you ask for the retry.

controls.label: Copy source
controls.title: Copy the diagram source to the clipboard
controls.doc: Copy the mermaid source to the clipboard.

controls.label: Add colours
controls.title: Append classDef colour classes taken from the board palette
controls.doc: Append classDef colour classes resolved from the live board tokens, so a hand-coloured node belongs to the palette instead of fighting it. Two families: `ring` colours the border only, `Fill` is solid. Appending twice is refused.

controls.label: Hide source
controls.title: Show or hide the source editor
controls.doc: Show or hide the source editor. The label follows the state, so it reads Show source once the editor is hidden.

gestures: type in the source editor — it saves as you type and re-renders after a short pause
hover a node for its mermaid key, which is what you need in order to edit the source
notes: 23 types render; only zenuml is unavailable.
Colours come from the board tokens; chart types ignore classDef.
In requirementDiagram, quote any `text:` containing punctuation.
